get.description:
Stream one of the demo's AI-generated clips (read-only, demo mode only, no sign-in: a `<video>` element
cannot send a bearer token, and these clips hold no farm data). Unknown names are 404; so is a clip whose Git LFS
content was never pulled.

post.description:
Play the sandbox insurer's assessment of a submitted claim for the demo: record what the insurer reports
(`under_review`, `more_info_requested`, `approved` with an optional stated settlement, `declined`). Recorded as a
provider event labeled sandbox; VEYRA never decides a claim or pays it.
202 while a threaded replay runs; 200 with the final status once a speed-0 replay has already finished.

A track observation, or a `zone_scan`: a muzzle scan in the camera's scan zone, handed to the one track inside
the zone (`handoff` says what happened; `observation` and `track` are null unless exactly one track was there).

schema.title: Response Get Catalog Api V1 Policies Catalog Get

post.description: Ask the sandbox insurer again whether a paid policy is active. Opens its own short sessions.
Re-ask the sandbox provider about an `unknown` action under its stored Idempotency-Key and apply the answer.
Prepare the action again from its own references; the new version needs a fresh approval.
Open a conversation about one animal with an intent: `find_insurance`, `file_claim`, or `track_claim`.

Send the farmer's turn (typed text, or one of the choices the agent offered) and get the agent's next turns.
`{"choice": {"key": "continue"}}` re-reads the records, for example after an approval.

file.description: A muzzle photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or short video (MP4, WebM, MOV).

schema.title: IdentityCheckRequest

CameraGalleryStatus.title: CameraGalleryStatus
CameraGalleryStatus.description: Whether this camera holds the farm's current muzzle gallery (`domain.gallery`).

scan_zone.description: The calibrated scan zone, if the camera has one.

animal.description: For `register_new`; defaults to the sample's proposal.

link_to.title: Link To
link_to.description: For `link_existing`: an animal id on this farm.

override_note.title: Override Note
override_note.description: Required to register a possible duplicate, or with a required view missing or an uncertain identity.

HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus
HealthStatus.description: A monitoring state from records (alerts, review notes, observations); never a diagnosis.

InsurerUpdateOut.title: InsurerUpdateOut
InsurerUpdateOut.description: An assessment update the sandbox insurer reported; the settlement and disbursement are the insurer's words.

MessageCreate.title: MessageCreate
MessageCreate.description: Exactly one of `text` (the farmer's words, kept as data) or `choice` (one the agent offered).

candidate_animal_id.title: Candidate Animal Id
candidate_animal_id.description: The matched animal; for a zone_scan, the scanned one.

ObservationIn.title: ObservationIn
ObservationIn.description:
One track observation, or (`event: "zone_scan"`) a muzzle scan in the camera's scan zone, which needs no
track, box, or visibility: it is handed to the one track inside the zone at `observed_at`, or to none.

observation.description: Null for a zone_scan without exactly one track in the zone.

anchor_at.title: Anchor At
anchor_at.description: Observation time of scenario t=0: replays are footage ending by now.

polygon.title: Polygon
polygon.description: [[x, y], ...] normalized 0-1 to the camera frame.

animal_id.title: Animal Id
animal_id.description: Who the muzzle matcher says was scanned.

ScenarioCameraEvent.title: ScenarioCameraEvent
ScenarioCameraEvent.description: A camera event: a muzzle scan made in the scan zone, handed to the one track inside it (or to none).

label.title: Label
label.description: The caption shown with the clip, e.g. that it is AI-generated.

animal_id.title: Animal Id
animal_id.description: The confirmed animal to associate, or null to unassign the track.
